project.name: Finesse Life — The Hotel
sourceOfTruth: FINESSE LIFE — Company Bible & Investor Brief.md
project.experience: A cinematic 1920s Art Deco hotel operating system for style, connection, commerce, memory, and intelligent orchestration.
project.penthouseCountRule: Penthouse is a premium scene within the VIP Room, not a 32nd counted room.
project.truthPolicy: Never imply a connected provider, confirmed booking, funded balance, approved commission, or authenticated access without server evidence.

recommendedStack.why: One typed language can define mobile UI, web UI, room metadata, API contracts, orchestration, webhooks, revenue events, workers, and integration adapters.
recommendedStack.mobile: Expo React Native + Expo Router + TypeScript
recommendedStack.web: Next.js App Router + TypeScript + Framer Motion
recommendedStack.api: TypeScript + Fastify or Next.js Route Handlers; keep provider adapters server-side
recommendedStack.contracts: Zod schemas with generated JSON Schema / OpenAPI
recommendedStack.data: Supabase Postgres for the existing Vercel app; do not introduce a second database for the same domain
recommendedStack.auth: Supabase Auth plus server-verified KeyLock sessions
recommendedStack.async: Typed job records with idempotency keys; queue provider can be added after the spine is stable
recommendedStack.storage: Cloudflare R2 or platform object storage with signed URLs
recommendedStack.observability: Sentry-compatible error tracking, structured logs, traceId on every orchestration request
nativeEscapeHatches: Swift/Kotlin only for proven platform-specific capabilities such as HealthKit, background tasks, or push extensions

metaCode.definition: Declarative TypeScript registries that tell the Orchestrator what each room can do.

designSystem.direction: High-fidelity 1920s Art Deco hotel: oxblood lacquer, black mirror, fluted brass, geometric sunbursts, cinematic grain, controlled light, editorial typography.

motion.reducedMotion: Replace essential motion with immediate semantic state changes

security: bind session to member/device where lawful
never store raw code in localStorage
publicKeyLock.note: Namespaced under /entrance because /api/keylock/enter and /api/keylock/verify already serve Backstage sessions in production.

sequence: sliding doors close into one dark brass surface
six digit puzzle materializes across the doors
digits 1-3 belong to left door and 4-6 to right door
security: separate challenge IDs and nonces from public KeyLock
VIP session is short-lived and scoped
